pregame.whyWatch: Division game: the Chiefs lead the AFC West at 4-0; the Chargers are 0-4, 4th.
pregame.pressurePoint: Chargers pass game vs Chiefs pass defense. The Chiefs are No. 2 of 32 at limiting explosive passes (1.12) and No. 14 in pass success allowed (45%). The Chargers rank No. 8 in pass explosiveness (1.40) and No. 30 in pass success rate (38%). A real edge, not a lock. The Chiefs keep the lid on. The Chargers should expect to drive the long way. Watch the longest Chargers completion. If it is under 25 yards at the half, the Chiefs have won the matchup.

edges.why: The Chiefs are No. 6 of 32 in passing-downs success (45%). The Chargers rank No. 28 on passing downs (45%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Chiefs convert the long downs the Chargers need to win. A third-and-8 is not a stop here.

The Chiefs are No. 13 of 32 in pass explosiveness (1.37) and No. 11 in pass success rate (49%). The Chargers rank No. 27 at limiting explosive passes (1.39) and No. 23 in pass success allowed (48%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. The Chiefs have the deep ball available. Watch whether the Chargers roll a safety over after the first one.
